pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly polygonal dark brown regions with soft to moderately sharp pixel gradients at the edges. The patches are primarily sub-rectangular or pentagonal on the mid-flank, becoming smaller and more rounded towards the limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-cream pathways forming a consistent topological mesh. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, with clear tri-point and quadri-point junction nodes.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A short, dark-haired mane is visible along the dorsal neck line, presenting a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette against the background sky.

other_distinctive_markers: Anterior neck and ventral regions are partially occluded by high-contrast, out-of-focus arboreal foliage in the foreground.
